title: Bash Log Analyzer
instruction: Write a bash script that reads an nginx access log from stdin and outputs the top 10 IP addresses by request count, formatted as 'COUNT IP' per line, sorted descending. Assume standard combined log format where IP is the first field.
expected_behavior: A concise bash one-liner or short script using awk, sort, uniq, and head to extract and rank IPs.
evaluation_criteria: Reads from stdin (not a hardcoded file)
Sorts by count in descending order
Output format is 'COUNT IP' per line
